label: EV-20
command_argv:
set -e; PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py --spec samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json --repeat 3 --output docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/after_submit.json >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
e=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence")
f=json.loads((e/"phase_a_freeze.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
b=json.loads((e/"before.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
a=json.loads((e/"after_submit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def projection(x): return [t for t in x["task_results"] if t["task_id"]!="T10"]
def digest(x): return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
tb=next(t for t in b["task_results"] if t["task_id"]=="T10")
ta=next(t for t in a["task_results"] if t["task_id"]=="T10")
checks={
 "target_hash_frozen": hashlib.sha256(Path("samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f["target_sha256"],
 "runner_hash_frozen": hashlib.sha256(Path("scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f["runner_sha256"],
 "non_t10_exact_match": projection(b)==projection(a),
 "t10_before_allow_callback_1": tb["actual"]["actual_decision"]=="ALLOW" and tb["actual"]["actual_callback_count"]==1,
 "t10_after_deny_callback_0": ta["actual"]["actual_decision"]=="DENY" and ta["actual"]["actual_callback_count"]==0,
 "after_repeat_three_identical": a["repeatability"]["all_identical"] and a["repeatability"]["repeat_count"]==3,
}
print("CHECKS="+json.dumps(checks,sort_keys=True))
print("NON_T10_BEFORE_SHA256="+digest(projection(b)))
print("NON_T10_AFTER_SHA256="+digest(projection(a)))
print("T10_BEFORE="+json.dumps({"decision":tb["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":tb["actual"]["actual_callback_count"]},sort_keys=True))
print("T10_AFTER="+json.dumps({"decision":ta["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":ta["actual"]["actual_callback_count"],"preflight_status":ta["actual"]["known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"],"forbidden_side_effects":ta["actual"]["forbidden_side_effects"]},sort_keys=True))
for name in ("duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate","callback_count_match_rate","unsafe_allow_rate","decision_reason_consistency_rate","governed_end_to_end_task_success_rate","product_observed_authoritative_trace_completeness_rate"):
 print(name+"="+json.dumps(a["metrics"][name],sort_keys=True))
print("REPEATABILITY="+json.dumps(a["repeatability"],sort_keys=True))
if not all(checks.values()): raise SystemExit(1)
PY
